dialog.content: Starting a new game will stop the current game and all progress will be lost.
dialog.title: Are you sure?

rules.title: Game rules
rules.intro: {seconds} seconds, a handful of words, and one person doing the talking.

how.title: How a round works
how.1: One of the team members tries to describe the words on the card, the other team members must guess these words.
how.2: After half a minute the time is up, and nothing more can be said or guessed.
how.3: The player who described the words indicates which words are guessed, each word is worth one point.

nots.title: The describer may not…
nots.1: Name names on the card. Words such as "the" and "a" are allowed.
nots.2: Name names derived from the name on the card.
nots.4: Refer to letters of the alphabet.

allowed.title: But go ahead and…
allowed.text: Humming, singing and gestures are allowed.

dialog.content: Choose at least one word list to start a game.
dialog.title: No word list chosen

teams.intro: Two teams is the minimum and all teams must consist of at least two players.
teams.title: Pick your teams
